name: Cloudflare Unified Billing (CF AI Gateway)
description: Full model catalog for Cloudflare AI Gateway with unified billing support. Exposes 150+ models from Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, xAI (Grok), DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, MiniMax, Moonshot Kimi, Workers AI frontier models, and more through a single gateway endpoint.

cfAiGatewayApiKey.description: AI Gateway credential used by the web search, web fetch, and image generation capabilities.

customDomain.description: AI Gateway custom domain (for example ai.example.com). Routes requests through the gateway endpoint and enables Cloudflare Access identity-aware controls for User Insights.
